reader.zh-Hant: 此模組提供可受 scope 限制的唯讀檔案讀取與摘要工具，適合給 readonly sub-agent 或受控分析流程使用。
reader.en: This module provides scope-limited readonly file reading and summarization tools for controlled analysis and readonly sub-agent workflows.
reader.ja: このモジュールは scope 制限付きの readonly 読み取り/要約ツールを提供し、readonly sub-agent の分析フローに適しています。

symbols.name: ReadWorkspaceFileTool
symbols.summary: Read UTF-8 text files within configured workspace scope, optionally by line range.

tool_contract.name: read_workspace_file
tool_contract.description: Read a text file inside the configured workspace scope by optional line range.

params.name: root_dir
params.description: Project root before optional scope subdirectory.

params.name: allowed_scope
params.description: If set, workspace_root becomes resolve(root_dir / allowed_scope).

methods.name: execute
methods.signature: execute(file_path: str, start_line: Optional[int] = None, end_line: Optional[int] = None, save_policy: str = 'inline', output_target: str = 'memory', output_path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]
methods.summary: Return numbered lines for the requested inclusive 1-based range; if both line args omitted, returns full file.
behavior: Paths must stay under workspace_root via relative_to; traversal outside scope is rejected.
UTF-8 / UTF-8-BOM decoding only; unsupported extensions return an explicit error listing allowed suffixes.

symbols.name: SummarizeWorkspaceFileTool
symbols.summary: Summarize scoped workspace files and extract keywords with Gemini-assisted fallback logic.

tool_contract.name: summarize_workspace_file
tool_contract.description: Summarize a text file inside the configured workspace scope and extract key topics.

params.name: root_dir
params.description: Project root before optional scope subdirectory.

methods.name: execute
methods.signature: execute(file_path: str, save_policy: str = 'inline', output_target: str = 'memory', output_path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]
methods.summary: Paragraph-level heuristics plus optional Gemini compression (GEMINI_KEY) for a short grounded summary block.
behavior: Source text truncated to max_summary_chars (12000) before paragraph split.
Returns structured text including keywords and per-paragraph mini-summaries when applicable.

runtime_notes.content: Paths escaping configured scope are rejected via relative_to checks.
Only supported text-like extensions are accepted to avoid binary decoding issues.
Both tools support save_policy/output_target/output_path and may return structured payload for runtime-managed file persistence.
